title: Esa and Dida win in Cape Town as Kipchoge kicks off World Tour — World Athletics report
claims: World Athletics describes the Sanlam Cape Town Marathon as a World Athletics Elite Label road race.
The race was held on Sunday 24 May 2026.
Mohamed Esa won the men's race in 2:04:55, with Yihunilign Adane second in 2:04:59 and Kalipus Lomwai third in 2:05:06.
Dera Dida won the women's race in 2:23:18, with Mestawut Fikir second in 2:23:46 and Waganesh Mekasha Amare third in 2:23:57.
Eliud Kipchoge finished in 2:13:29 at the start of his seven-continent World Tour.
The men's lead group passed halfway in 1:02:49 and Esa made his decisive move at 40 km.
The women's lead group passed halfway in 1:12:33, with six athletes still in contention at 35 km.
The event was live-streamed on World Athletics+.
